abilities.name: Kaboom!
_curatorNotes: Current-patch Boom Badge system (article evidence, no gcsim source available): one badge per DMG type dealt (Normal Attack / Skill / Burst), each lasting 20s on its own independent timer, max 1 badge per type. At 1/2/3 badges the Boom-Boom Strike deals 115%/130%/150% of its original DMG. Pure own-hit DMG multiplier with per-type stack machinery — not authorable as an effect (site constitution: no damage math); surfaced via the caveat instead.

9f lag: gcsim adds 9 frames to swap/N/C cancel frames when normals are used immediately after skill, burst, or dash state (attackFramesWithLag). Values here are base attackFrames (no lag). Effective with lag: N1 swap=25, N=40, C=32; N2 swap=32, N=47, C=41.

chargeFrames: gcsim applies 14-frame windup when charged attack is used after N2 (NormalCounter==1), N3 (NormalCounter==2), or SkillState. Values recorded are raw slice values before windup subtraction. Effective with windup: swap=90, N=45, E=45, Q=45, D=17, J=16.
plungeFrames: high plunge also exists in gcsim (highPlungeFrames: swap=53, N=60, E=61, Q=48, D=48, J=68). Low plunge used here as standard rotation plunge.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Badges are a pure own-hit DMG multiplier (115%/130%/150%) — damage math, constitutionally frozen and never printed anywhere. Stacks have no counter on any surface either (there is no stack readout in the planner), so an authored badge system would have changed no bar, no marker and no tick. Three quarters of the text is a scaling table, which is the definition of trivia in a 262px column. It also sits on the base normal ability, so it fires for every Klee rotation. Category: invisible-omission.

abilities.name: Jumpy Dumpty
_curatorNotes: Jumpy Dumpty mines: the 3rd bounce (absolute frame ~140 from cast start) splits into mines deployed on the ground as persistent deployable entities. gcsim models them as scheduled explosion events (default mine_delay=240 frames from cast start = 4s total) rather than persistent lifetime tracking. Actual mine duration from game data and exact spawnsAt need KQM verification. Not modeled in summons[].

skillCanceledFrames: gcsim defines an alternate frame slice (ActionBurst=5 instead of 34) used when sim parameter release==0. This is a simulation optimization for burst-canceling the skill animation; not a separate in-game variant.
abilities.description:
Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun! 
When thrown, Jumpy Dumpty bounces thrice, igniting and dealing AoE Pyro DMG with every bounce.

On the third bounce, the bomb splits into many mines.
The mines will explode upon contact with opponents, or after a short period of time, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Starts with 2 charges.

abilities.name: Sparks 'n' Splash
_curatorNotes: Hexerei Secret Rite (article evidence, no gcsim source available; ≥2 Hexerei in party): during Sparks 'n' Splash the Normal Attack sequence does not reset, and the 3rd attack consumes 1 Spark to fire an extra attack equivalent to the Boom-Boom Strike. Attack-sequence machinery plus an own-hit DMG instance with no published scaling — authored as a factionBonuses entry with a description only (no effects); the mechanic is surfaced via the caveat.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — that a reader could point at. "The Normal Attack string stops resetting" is an input-sequence fact — the timeline draws exactly the swings the player TYPED, so no drawn block is wrong; and "every third attack spends a Spark for an extra strike" is an extra DMG instance whose only renderable residue (a Pyro application pip) belongs to an unauthored, Spark-stock-gated, Hexerei-gated mechanic behind the opt-in aura lane (P25). This is kit explanation for a Hexerei team, not a repair of anything on screen. Category: kit-explanation.
abilities.description: Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

passives.name: Pounding Surprise
_curatorNotes: Current-patch A1 rework (article evidence, no gcsim source available): sparks still come from Jumpy Dumpty and Normal Attack hits at a 50% chance, but the Skill and the Burst now grant 1 Spark each, and up to 3 Sparks can be held at once. A Charged Attack still consumes 1 for a stamina-free strike with +50% DMG. Stack machinery plus an own-hit DMG multiplier — not authorable as effects; caveat only. The `description` field below still carries the pre-rework kit text (genshin-db has not been regenerated for this patch).

Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. A1 Pounding Surprise: gcsim grants 'a1-spark' status (30s duration, 5s ICD between procs) on E bounce/mine hit and normal attack hit, with 50% proc chance each. Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack: 0 Stamina cost + 50% additive DMG bonus (stats[DmgP] += 0.5). Likely onHit trigger on E/normal, self-buff on charged attack. Ascension 1 gated.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Its two payloads are stamina (not modelled anywhere, and the planner will draw a `C` swing whether or not you could afford it in game) and a +50% own-hit DMG bonus (frozen). No spark counter, no resource lane, no bar length changes. A player who reads this learns something true about Klee and nothing about the chart in front of them. Category: invisible-omission.
passives.description:
When Jumpy Dumpty and Normal Attacks deal DMG, Klee has a 50% chance to obtain an Explosive Spark.
This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.

passives.name: Sparkling Burst

_curatorNotes: ↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-18 (caveat refresh): effect-level caveat, no reader — and the claim was also wrong about the surface. Kit fact retained: the Energy only flows when the Charged Attack hit CRITs.

A4 Sparkling Burst authored 2026-07-29 (sweep finding: wiki base-kit energy vs our C6-only gate). gcsim: fires on Charged Attack CRIT hit, 0.6s ICD (36 frames) between procs, +2 Elemental Energy to all party members. CRIT condition is not schema-expressible — optimistic onHit render, caveated.
passives.description: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy.

constellations.name: Chained Reactions
constellations.caveat: Shown on every qualifying hit, but the sparks are a chance proc — in game the ATK bonus lands much less often.
_curatorNotes: Current-patch C1 addition (article evidence, no gcsim source available): after the spark bombardment triggers, Klee gains +60% ATK for 12s. Authored as a self atk% buff on the same hits that can roll the proc (normal/charged/plunge/skill, mirroring the gcsim proc surface below); the 10%+8%-per-failure proc chance has no schema primitive, so the buff renders on every qualifying hit — surfaced via the caveat (Noelle Breastplate precedent). Recipient scope is read as Klee herself; article text does not say 'party'. The 120%-of-burst spark DMG itself stays unauthored (own-hit DMG).

C1 spark DMG (pre-existing note): gcsim fires a 'Sparks'n'Splash (C1)' attack (Mult = 1.2 × burst scaling, burst DMG tag) on attacks and skill hits. Probabilistic proc: 10% base chance, +8% per failure, resets to 10% on success. Note: this is not an extra E charge — Klee has 2 charges by default.
constellations.description: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash's DMG.

constellations.name: Explosive Frags
_curatorNotes: C2 authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim internal/characters/klee/cons.go:41-52 — AddDefMod -0.233 (key 'kleec2'), 10*60f = 10s, attached as callback on the Jumpy Dumpty mine attack (skill.go:145). Value -23.3 per gcsim; kit text rounds to 23%. The shred anchors to the skill hit; in-game it applies at the later mine detonations — the few-second offset is an accepted approximation (mines are not a modeled sub-ability).
constellations.description: Being hit by Jumpy Dumpty's mines decreases opponents' DEF by 23% for 10s.

constellations.name: Exquisite Compound
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Jumpy Dumpty by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sparkly Explosion
_curatorNotes: Current-patch C4 addition (article evidence, no gcsim source available): the departure explosion deals +100% DMG if Klee is on-field when it lands. Own-hit DMG multiplier — not authored; the 555% ATK scaling below is unchanged. The on-field-at-landing wording is ambiguous in the source article (Klee has just left the field to trigger it), so no caveat was written for it — needs kit-text confirmation.

Inherited manual trigger — do not rewrite. Probable trigger: onSwap, fires when Klee swaps off-field while burst status ('kleeq') is active. gcsim: event.OnCharacterSwap checks kleeq duration > 0, deletes status, then queues 5.55× ATK AoE Pyro hit (attack type: none, not burst-tagged). Fires at 0-frame delay. Target scope: enemies near Klee's position at time of swap.
constellations.description: If Klee leaves the field during the duration of Sparks 'n' Splash, her departure triggers an explosion that deals 555% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

constellations.description:

constellations.name: Blazing Delight
_curatorNotes: C6 Blazing Delight: pyroDmgBonus buff unchanged in the current patch (article evidence still reads 10% Pyro DMG Bonus to all party members for 25s on burst use). Energy regen authored 2026-07-29 (Hexerei wave): gcsim fires every 3s (180 frames) from burstStart+180 through burstStart+600, granting +3 energy to all party members except Klee while 'kleeq' is active. Authored as a single duration-scoped energy effect with the PER-TICK amount (3) over the 10s burst window — the per-3s cadence is not expressible (Dori Alcazarzaray's Exactitude / Escoffier Rehab Diet precedent).
Article evidence also mentions current-patch 'spark economy chances' on C6 without published numbers — not authored; needs kit text.
constellations.description:
While under the effects of Sparks 'n' Splash, Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s.
When Sparks 'n' Splash is used, all party members will gain a 10% Pyro DMG Bonus for 25s.

factionBonuses.description: When 2+ Hexerei members are in the team, Klee's Normal Attack sequence no longer resets during Sparks 'n' Splash, and every 3rd Normal Attack consumes 1 Spark to fire an extra attack equal to the Boom-Boom Strike.
